setup.effects: Provisions owner Cloudflare resources, checks sender DNS, applies migrations and initializes page/operator settings.

deploy.effects: Runs verification and setup, uploads configured secrets and Worker, then checks health. Ordered migrations include the selected owner SQL after core; migration failure stops the update.

verify.effects: Runs local source, Workers, browser and generated-artifact checks; no hosted acceptance claim. Includes isolated owner-migration ordering, rerun and rollback checks.

authentication.deployment: Owner-controlled Cloudflare API token and account ID.
authentication.operators: Native emailed sign-in; no local bypass.

health.semantics: App-host dependency health; local input checks never assert deployed health.
